title: Jolt: Out-of-bounds heap access when CCD body collides with soft body
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.7.dev [223c9417bd3f5cb5df89858a778db9967e7a279a]
- Likely reproducible in: 4.6.2.stable

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev (223c9417b) - Fedora Linux 43 (Forty Three) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Single-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (RADV GFX1201) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 60.39 GiB memory

### Issue description

In a `use_asan=yes` build, if you enable `continuous_cd` on a `RigidBody3D` and have it collide with a `SoftBody3D`, you end up with a `heap-buffer-overflow` ASan crash:

```
ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow on address 0x7d0ff7b8c630 at pc 0x0000074d5ff6 bp 0x7fffffffc470 sp 0x7fffffffc468
READ of size 4 at 0x7d0ff7b8c630 thread T0

    #4 0x000007299184 in JPH::ContactConstraintManager::OnCCDContactAdded(JPH::ContactConstraintManager::ContactAllocator&, JPH::Body const&, JPH::Body const&, JPH::ContactManifold const&, JPH::ContactSettings&) thirdparty/jolt_physics/Jolt/Physics/Constraints/ContactConstraintManager.cpp:1419:23
    #5 0x0000070d1d6f in JPH::PhysicsSystem::JobFindCCDContacts(JPH::PhysicsUpdateContext const*, JPH::PhysicsUpdateContext::Step*) thirdparty/jolt_physics/Jolt/Physics/PhysicsSystem.cpp:2074:20
    #6 0x0000070e1495 in JPH::PhysicsSystem::JobPostIntegrateVelocity(JPH::PhysicsUpdateContext*, JPH::PhysicsUpdateContext::Step*) const::$_0::operator()() const thirdparty/jolt_physics/Jolt/Physics/PhysicsSystem.cpp:1753:32
    #7 0x0000070e1495 in void std::__invoke_impl<void, JPH::PhysicsSystem::JobPostIntegrateVelocity(JPH::PhysicsUpdateContext*, JPH::PhysicsUpdateContext::Step*) const::$_0&>(std::__invoke_other, JPH::PhysicsSystem::JobPostIntegrateVelocity(JPH::PhysicsUpdateContext*, JPH::PhysicsUpdateContext::Step*) const::$_0&)
    #8 0x0000070e1495 in std::enable_if<is_invocable_r_v<void, JPH::PhysicsSystem::JobPostIntegrateVelocity(JPH::PhysicsUpdateContext*, JPH::PhysicsUpdateContext::Step*) const::$_0&>, void>::type std::__invoke_r<void, JPH::PhysicsSystem::JobPostIntegrateVelocity(JPH::PhysicsUpdateContext*, JPH::PhysicsUpdateContext::Step*) const::$_0&>(JPH::PhysicsSystem::JobPostIntegrateVelocity(JPH::PhysicsUpdateContext*, JPH::PhysicsUpdateContext::Step*) const::$_0&)
    #9 0x0000070e1495 in std::_Function_handler<void (), JPH::PhysicsSystem::JobPostIntegrateVelocity(JPH::PhysicsUpdateContext*, JPH::PhysicsUpdateContext::Step*) const::$_0>::_M_invoke(std::_Any_data const&)
    #10 0x00000708f7b5 in std::function<void ()>::operator()() const
    #11 0x00000708f7b5 in JPH::JobSystem::Job::Execute() thirdparty/jolt_physics/Jolt/Core/JobSystem.h:245:5
    #12 0x00000708f7b5 in JPH::JobSystemWithBarrier::BarrierImpl::Wait() thirdparty/jolt_physics/Jolt/Core/JobSystemWithBarrier.cpp:140:16
    #13 0x0000070c9630 in JPH::PhysicsSystem::Update(float, int, JPH::TempAllocator*, JPH::JobSystem*) thirdparty/jolt_physics/Jolt/Physics/PhysicsSystem.cpp:625:15
    #14 0x0000074facac in JoltSpace3D::step(float) modules/jolt_physics/spaces/jolt_space_3d.cpp:196:64
    #15 0x000007430fa1 in JoltPhysicsServer3D::step(float) modules/jolt_physics/jolt_physics_server_3d.cpp:1631:17
    #16 0x000004fcd1f1 in Main::iteration() main/main.cpp:5010:37
    #17 0x000004e99104 in OS_LinuxBSD::run() platform/linuxbsd/os_linuxbsd.cpp:1006:7
    #18 0x000004ec4db6 in main platform/linuxbsd/godot_linuxbsd.cpp:122:6
    #19 0x7ffff79e45b4 in __libc_start_call_main (/lib64/libc.so.6+0x35b4)
    #20 0x7ffff79e4667 in __libc_start_main@GLIBC_2.2.5 (/lib64/libc.so.6+0x3667)
    #21 0x000004d91164 in _start (bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64.llvm.san+0x4d91164)

0x7d0ff7b8c630 is located 24 bytes after 216-byte region [0x7d0ff7b8c540,0x7d0ff7b8c618)
allocated by thread T0 here:
    #0 0x000004e36658 in malloc (bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64.llvm.san+0x4e36658)
    #1 0x00001079e16f in void* Memory::alloc_static<false>(unsigned long, bool) core/os/memory.cpp:115:9
    #2 0x00001079e16f in operator new(unsigned long, char const*) core/os/memory.cpp:43:9

SUMMARY: AddressSanitizer: heap-buffer-overflow ./core/templates/local_vector.h:162:48 in LocalVector<JoltBody3D::Contact, unsigned int, false, false>::is_empty() const
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Run the MRP scene in a `use_asan=yes` build (or Application Verifier on Windows).
2. Note the crash.
3. Disable CCD on the `RigidBody3D`.
4. Note how it runs fine.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[jolt-ccd-soft-crash.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26544698/jolt-ccd-soft-crash.zip)
